conventions.intent_vs_render: halcyon and indus-foods are Bean's own Claude Design drafts. Where the SOURCE declares behaviour the RUNTIME did not perform, the family records both, tagged 'intent' and 'render'.
conventions.away_storefront: away.json describes the US storefront the headless run received; a headed Chrome is served the UK storefront (GBP, /en-gb, first two nav items swapped, no consent banner). Structure is identical; only labels and currency differ. The UK storefront is the reference.
conventions.presence: decided by what a visitor sees, not by an HTML tag. resn has no <header> element but is 'present' as shell-less fixed controls.
conventions.butcherbox_rabbit: 768 was never captured for either, and rabbit's footer was never captured at any tier. Their absence from a needed_by list is a capture gap, not a measured 'absent'.
